avis.texte: I've used this oil cleanser both in the balm form and the oil formula and both are great. Love the slight citrus scent, love the silky hydrating feeling and love that it removes all my makeup on the first try. I switched from the oil to the balm last year because it's easier to transfer some to a travel container and not worry about it leaking or counting towards the TSA liquids limits. I was nervous about using the balm because most other cleansing balms give me cloudy eyes but this one never does!

This is the first cleansing balm ive ever used. After a week of using it i started getting random , large/deep, pimples. They cleared once i stopped using it. Guess its not for all skin types. I have sensitive skin.
this stuff is great, does not irritate my skin in any fashion, I believe it's actually helped improve my skin and I'm reminded how well it works when I don't use it, which isn't often
I bought this as the liquid version was out of stock, and I'm sticking with this; so easy to use and works so well.

avis.titre: Best cleansing balm I've tried so far
avis.texte: This cleansing balm washes out a lot more easily than other ones, which makes double cleansing at night much more approachable. The citrus scent is refreshing, but not overpowering.

I had been using Clinique Balm & bought Hanskin based on reviews. I have sensitive skin & this balm works great at removing waterproof makeup without any breakouts . I follow up with CeraVe Hydrating Face cleanser & my skin is looking even better after using Hanskin Balm. Highly recommend!
Does not remove make up So if you are a full face makeup wearer don't purchase thinking it will work - wont

As a self proclaimed skin care junkie I can tell you I have tried so many different brands and I have been using a combo Lamer/ estee Lauder exfoliating cleanser for cleansing this one inexpensive item knocks it out of the park. I already immediately recommended to my bestie and have more products on the way. The smell is great and i keep telling people to feel my face. This is the first review I have done because its that good.
A little goes a long way with this light weight cleansing balm. Gentle enough for sensitive skin!

I used this to take off my full face of makeup after a long day of work, the product is oil based and pretty much evaporated my foundation and powder into a liquid form was easy to wash off like a cleanser, I used a cotton round to remove excess
This product literally melts away all of my waterproof makeup! Can't leave without it!!!!

I have a very sensitive skin and this cleansing balm works perfect for me. It goes on so smooth and has such a silky feeling! It removes eye makeup and waterproof mascara. I love it and couldn't recommend enough.
Bought this balm based on the reviews. Have had break outs like never before! Good Molecules cleansing balm works way better for me. Will not purchase again. Does nothing to remove mascara either.

I'm a huge fan of double cleansing. It's a must for me to make my face feel as clean as possible. This is the best cleansing balm I've ever used. I use it with dry hands directly on my face as is, WITHOUT any water and it just melts everything down so incredibly easily. Then I rinse it off with water and go in with my cleanser. Loveeee this stuff. You just have to try it for yourself!

I use this product to double cleanse and I use it without any water. I'll put a little on dry hands and put it directly on my face dry as well. It melts down EVERYTHING so easily. Breaks up the sunscreen, foundation, blush, mascara, etc with such ease! It's a must try!! I've tried a good amount of oils and balms and this is by far a holy grail!
I use with double cleansing and it's amazing… smells amazing and leaves my skin clean and supple

avis.titre: The best cleanser I've tried yet
avis.texte: I love this face cleanser!It has the texture and look of coconut oil but does not clog your pores.My face feels so soft and clean after each use! I've been using daily for about 4 months now and have had no issues.

I use this as my first cleanse, which is the longest part of my nightly routine. I am so used to the citrus scent that when I tried clean it zero's cleansing balm I nearly gagged at the bubblegum-like smell. Just a general complaint about most cleansing balms: there is never enough product! 2-3 oz makes no sense when most gel, oil, and foaming cleansers come in much higher quantities like 5-10 oz.
Good cleansing balm. Fairly pricy compared to other ones I like more but it's good and does it's job.

I have and love the Hanskin PHA cleansing oil so when I saw the balm version it was an easy decision to give it a try. It's pretty much the best cleansing balm I've used. Not sticky (cough, Elemis) and it doesn't sting my eyes, despite the inclusion of PHAs. Fully removes my light makeup, including mascara. I followed with a water-based cleanser and my skin is silky-smooth and clear.
I don't really know why. I have never had an allergic reaction to a skincare product before but my face swelled and my eye turned red for about 12 hours.
My first cleansing balm and it is amazing. Love the way the product melts, it feels luxurious and very gentle. Cleans without stripping or leaving a film on the skin like some other cleansing oils.

Does the job, but probably wouldn't buy again. Personally, I think the mix of oils in this creates a scent that is just too strong for me, especially for something that I'm putting all over my face. Also, be sure to read the instructions and rub the balm on your DRY face, then wash off with water! I initially was using it after wetting my face and noticed that it wasn't really taking anything off. I usually rub it in for about a 30 seconds to a minute (especially for eye makeup removal) and it seems to be a bit more effective that way. Just not in love with it, I'm definitely going to try a different brand after I finish up this balm.

Be careful, the first ingredient is Ethylhexyl Palmitate which is a pore clogger. I did not do my due diligence and check before I chose the PHA (Sensitive Skin) version of this Hanskin cleansing balm. The AHA and BHA ingredient lists look safer for acne-prone skin like mine. I try to avoid fragrances but did not mind the citrusy scent of this product. I tried it as the first step in my double cleanse, and the second step (gel cleanser) was necessary as this balm does not rinse away with water alone.
I use this for makeup removal. I slather it on before I get in the shower at night to remove makeup as part of a double cleanse method.

Finally found a cleanser that's worth it! All cleansers (even for sensitive, dry skin) leave my skin super dry and stripped. This one does not. The consistency takes some getting used to, but it's so creamy and leaves the skin exfoliated (yes, you CAN exfoliate sensitive skin!!) and hydrated.

I love this product SO MUCH. I love Hanskin and after saying goodbye to an irritating cleansing oil, I was delightfully surprised that this worked really well for me. I always use this in a double cleansing system (use this first, rinse, then cleanser.) The only downside is it contains Polyethylene which is made from tiny bits of plastic which is bad for the environment.

avis.titre: Would definitely recommend for makeup removal
avis.texte: Would definitely recommend this to anyone with sensitive skin for makeup removal! it's a solid consistency until you work it into your skin - didn't break me out at all even though i have sensitive skin, and effectively removed my waterproof mascara.

I use this before I use my face wash, and it truly just helps soften the skin and preps it for a second cleanse. It helps break down mascara, primers, and eyeliners it a gentler way. No need for harsh scrubbing!

This is my first time using a cleansing balm and I love it! It smells great and does a great job taking off my makeup. It feels like my makeup melts away and it leaves my skin feeling great. I've used it for about 6 weeks and my skill feels really moisturized and vibrant. In the past few days I've received several compliments on my skin (when I haven't been wearing makeup), which prompted me to write this review. I will definitely buy it again!

This is my first time using a cleansing balm and I love it! It smells great and does a great job taking off my makeup. It feels like my makeup melts away and it leaves my skin feeling great. I've used it for about 6 weeks and my skill feels really moisturized and vibrant. In the past few days I've received several compliments on my skin (when I haven't been wearing makeup), which prompted me to write this review. I will definitely buy it again!

I only wear a bit of concealer under my eyes and around my face with one layer of mascara and this product barely takes off my mascara and needs foaming cleanser to get the smeared makeup off my skin. When I dry my face, it feels like it sticks to my eyelashes and doesn't go away.

avis.titre: This is the only cleanser you need!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleansing balm! It effectively removes makeup and doesn't leave my skin dry. This is by far the best cleanser I have ever used!

avis.titre: Great removing makeup and Lipsense lipstick
avis.texte: I use this product to remove makeup. It has a citrus smell which I like. I have sensitive skin so it works well for me. After cleansing, it leaves my skin moist and smooth. It also works well to remove Lipsense lipstick. Great product!

avis.titre: Great make up remover, but have not used it otherwise.
avis.texte: I think this is a great make up remover but I have not used it otherwise. I definitely have to wash my face with another cleanser afterward because normal water did not work for me to wash it off.
This cleansing balm is awesome - very moisturizing but not too heavy. It works great with my sensitive skin. 10/10, would recommend.

avis.titre: I would recommend this product to a friend.
avis.texte: I would definitely recommend this product to a friend. It was very easy to use and it didn't make my skin dry. It's very easy to take off after use. There's a good amount of product which lasted a month of consistent daily use and especially for the price. I will be buying this product again!
This product was great! I use it before my foam cleanser and I feel that it really gets rid of all of the impurities built up over the day.

At first I was a little skeptical on a balm to remove my make up but once I started using it for a couple weeks it has been my go to every single time I wear make up! It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and soft and I have never broken out from it!!!! I pick this over using make up wipes or any type of removing water! Also has an amazing smell! I will definitely be buying more when I run out! Which won't be for a while because a little goes a long way!!

this is such a great cleansing balm. only very little is needed to melt all the makeup and dialy impurities off your face!! super gentle yet powerful to get your face in a nice clean state, ready to be washed off with a second cleanser. my sister has SUPER sensitive skin and she LOVES this, she takes my cleanser and uses it all the time haha. and the smell is a refreshing ylang ylang/citrus smell

This product is so gentle on skin. I have sensitive skin and this was perfect for me, it melted my make up away in seconds and it smells sooo good. Plus it will last for a while since you don't need much to remove make up. I definitely then use a cleanser to remove all the residues but this definitely removes most of it.
I have been using the Hanskin Pore Cleansing Balm for three weeks now. I love the citrus smell and it melts my make-up away after a long day! Very refreshing! It also comes with a helpful applicator.

To be honest, I wasn't sure how to use this product. I first used before going to bed, with the product still on my face while I slept. However, the outcome of me sleeping with the product on still helped with the dryness of my skin. After using a cleanser for my skin, I use the product in addition to my skincare routine. I notice that the pimples and bumps on my skin diminish, closing my pores.
I have been using this for several weeks and I love the results! A small amount of the cleansing balm goes a long ways and leaves my face feeling moisturized. I would buy this again!

This is one of the best make up removers i have ever used! I used this product for a couple of weeks now and I use make up pretty often. Usually make up wipes can irritate my skin leaving redness and irritation. This pore cleansing balm is a gentle make up remover and it makes my face feel so clean after use. A little does go a long way with this product! It really does give me a glass skin look without make up! A must-have!

I have been using the Pore Cleansing Balm for nearly a month now and I am IN LOVE. My skin is very sensitive, and make up wipes can definitely irritate my skin when I use them. Since I use make up frequently and need to take it off, this pore cleansing balm is perfect. A little goes a long way with this product as it helps remove all make up! I can truly say I probably won't be using make up wipes any time soon because this product gets the job done and it does not irritate my skin at all. Just apply a good amount with the tool provided on your face, rub it in, then rinse it off! I like to put on facial cleanser after to make sure everything is off as well! Amazing product, a definite MUST HAVE!

avis.titre: Necessity for Korean double cleansing routine
avis.texte: I am an advocate for the Korean double cleansing method because this is the best method for creating a clean skin base. Ive tried many varieties of cleansing oils and balms and this by far has one of the best consistencies. In the balm field, Ive tried balms from Drunk Elephant and Farmacy. Drunk Elephant is too thick and forces me to put a lot of pressure on my skin to move the oil around. I really dislike this because its not good to pull and tug on the sensitive skin around the eye area. Farmacy is too "light" and doesnt get all of my eye makeup off. The one from Hanskin melts onto my skin and glides smoothly all over my face and gets literally all of my make up off. It doesnt leave an overly stripped feeling on my face, nor does it leave an oily residue like the one from Drunk Elephant. I would highly recommend this as part of your cleansing routing.

This cleansing balm is great to remove makeup and cleanse the face. I love using it before I use my other facial cleanser even though this alone is sufficient since it melts into a beautiful milky texture. No oily or greasy feeling, just smooth balanced, comfortable skin. Plus an amazing light lemon accent !!

I love this cleansing balm! I like to use once for makeup removal and then use a gentle cleanser, or I will go in twice with the cleansing balm to both remove my makeup and cleanse (when my skin is on the drier side). Absolutely love the spatula to help scoop the product out! No breakouts, skin balanced and plump! Try this.

I love using this product to take off my makeup. If I didn't wear makeup the day, then I would use micellar water instead. But it feels so much better to wipe off all the make up with this product and watching it become like facewash when I wash it off. My face feels so clean afterwards and not oily at all.

This product is different than any other makeup remover or cleanser I've tried. It seems like it's going to last forever because it only take a small amount to cover my face and loosen my makeup. I do have oily/combo skin, so I always follow with a cleanser, but this is so gentle, I am glad to have it in my night-time routine.

avis.titre: AMAZING scent and gentle on sensitive skin
avis.texte: I'm so happy to have found another amazing cleansing balm! I'm always on the look out for balm cleansers that are moisturizing enough for dry skin, but also not too oily to the point that it would be difficult to wash off with just a second step cleansing foam. This is also one of the best scents I've come across in a balm cleanser. 10/10!

avis.titre: Great makeup remover for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I love this cleansing balm. This is the first step in my nightly routine. I use the provided spatula to scoop some of the balm into my fingertips. I rub the balm for a couple seconds until it starts to melt and apply to my face. I rub in circular motions and it removes all my makeup! No need to for makeup remover wipes anymore. It makes my face feel very clean and fresh and i follow it up with a double cleanse.

avis.titre: Nice addition to night time routine
avis.texte: I was looking for a double cleanser to add into my routine and so far I'm happy with this product. It has a very mild scent which doesn't bother me or my skin and does a great job of removing all of my makeup. The texture is nice and spreads easily. Overall, I think it's a good value as they don't short you on the product and I expect this to last me a while as a little goes a long way.

This is the first step of my routine. It melts quickly into an oil and is very easy to spread around to wash face, and not tug on it. The balm is very light but very effective. It also comes with a spatula so it's hygienic. It is meant for sensitive skin and it didn't irritate my skin at all. My skin felt skin, "felt like it was breathing" but did not feel dry or tight. Although I must say that the scent was slightly jarring as it was unexpected, but rest assure it dissipates really quickly, you get used to it/ don't notice it very fast and it does not irritate the skin.

I use this product to remove makeup and any gunk on my face. I love how natural this product feels. It also makes my skin feel so soft. The packaging is also really nice and makes my counter look pretty! I would definitely recommend this product to people with sensitive skin as well, as it is soothing and not harsh.

avis.titre: Wonderful Makeup Remover for Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: Such a great product!! Really takes makeup and dirt off in a non-drying way! The product feels so smooth and hydrating on the skin while applying. Quickly takes off makeup, and is easily removed with a cloth! Kept my skin feeling soft and moisturized after use!!

I was really happy with this product! It's a great alternative to makeup wipes and didn't irritate my skin. It doesn't remove all my makeup, so I do follow up with a cleanser - but it does a great job loosening up my mascara. Affordable, too!

Good cleanser, removes all dirt and makeup throughout the day. Smells great. The only issue was texture inside the container but once you know it in your hands it becomes a nice balmy cleanser. No issue with breakouts which is great.

avis.titre: Cleanses all my make up sins away!
avis.texte: I would recommend this for anyone who uses make up everyday! I feel like it's important to cleanse the face first by loosening up the make up before washing it with your daily cleanser. This product easily does that for me! I have waterproof mascara and eyeliner and it definitely gets most of the residue out of my eyes! It can be a little messy, so i would recommend using a small amount at a time, it goes a long way! I didn't break out from it, if anything, it made my face less irritated compared to make up wipes I used before. Highly recommend! I'm only giving it four stars because your make up does end up getting all melted and messy on your face until you wash it off!.

avis.titre: Cleanses all my make up sins away!
avis.texte: I would recommend this for anyone who uses make up everyday! I feel like it's important to cleanse the face first by loosening up the make up before washing it with your daily cleanser. This product easily does that for me! I have waterproof mascara and eyeliner and it definitely gets most of the residue out of my eyes! It can be a little messy, so i would recommend using a small amount at a time, it goes a long way! I didn't break out from it, if anything, it made my face less irritated compared to make up wipes I used before. Highly recommend!

I love this cleanser! It's an excellent makeup remover (even my superstar lipstick!), and leaves my skin feeling soft. I have very sensitive skin and this hasn't irritated my skin at all or made me break out. Highly recommend
I liked that this product is light (feels like a lighter version of vasoline). After washing my face with it, my skin didn't feel dried out at all.

This product was very easy to use. It left my skin feeling nice and soft afterwards. My skin tends to be sensitive with some products but this product had nothing but a positive impact on my skin. One thing I would recommend would be to have more descriptive instructions as it wasn't super clear. Overall it was a nice cleanser to use with easy application and wash.

avis.titre: Smells Great, Feels Great, Gentle on the skin
avis.texte: Love the smell of the product and overall it was really easy to use. It's not too harsh on the skin which helps definitely, but for someone who has suffered from acne for a long time, it just didn't clean my skin as well. Overall though, the feeling afterwards was amazing. I gave mine away to my girlfriend and she loves using the product.
This cleansing balm is gentle to use and easy on the skin without drying it out. You can actually see your makeup come off which is great!

I love this cleanser. It smells incredible and it is very easy to use. I sometimes find that oil cleansers are hard to rinse off, this one melts of beautifully with a little warm water. But it still has hydrating effects that last after a follow-up water based cleanse. I sort of discovered this on accident, but it also makes a really great DIY oil planing medium. I manage the hair on my upper lip with those drugstore eyebrow shavers. Usually I take care of that before my evening cleanse, but I mixed up the order and now I will always apply this oil cleanser first. It removed more hair than normal with NO irritation and with less effort.

The citrus scent is light and reminds me of summer :) I use this EVERY DAY and I love that I only need to use a little bit of the product to remove my makeup! I started wearing heavy eyeliner and thicker mascara and the balm removes my makeup completely while being super gentle on the skin! The product is technically a one-step cleanser, but I like to use my regular face wash after the balm, and my skin still feels moisturized! The balm is totally worth your money and will legit last you for a while!!
I used this product to remove my makeup, it was gentle on my skin since I do have sensitive skin and I like how my skin feels after applying, it feels very smooth.

I really like the smell and feel of this product, and it feels like a salve or balm. Initially I was hesitant to use such a dense product on my face (I was worried it would clog my pores) but I've been using it and it's not too heavy on my skin. I will say, the directions could be clearer because I wasn't sure I was using the product correctly.

When I'm taking off my makeup, a cleansing balm is always my preferred way to go and I like this product better than any other's I've tried. In the past I have used Clinique's Take Off The Day Cleansing Balm and Green Clean from Farmacy and I like this one better than both of those, plus its much cheaper! This takes off all my makeup, even waterproof mascara, and is really gentle on my skin. Also, I am SUPER acne prone and it hasn't broken me out at all! I follow it up with a water based cleanser, because I like to double cleanse, but it would also be fine on its own. You only need a little bit and in fact I find if you use too much of it, it creates a bit of a film on your face, so you only want a bit. I took a look at the ingredients list and I'm really happy with it, great oils in this formula.
I really enjoyed this cleansing balm. I have really sensitive skin and this didn't break me out nor did irritate my skin !! it remove all of my make up with no issues. Definitely recommend.

avis.titre: Gentle and very cleansing as the first cleanse step
avis.texte: I like this even better than the clinique cleansing balm and it's gentle. Love it!

I just finished my first jar of this! It is a really great cleansing balm for the price. It has a solid but creamy texture at room temperature that instantly melts into a lightweight oil when you apply it to your skin. It melts makeup really quickly--even waterproof mascara--so you don't have to tug and rub your skin for a long time to get a good effect. It has no scent so it's not irritating to your eyes, but your eyes will get cloudy if you get some in there! Rinses very clean, no oily after-feel on the skin. I follow it with a micellar water, and I have to say, I've been super impressed by how clean my skin is after just this. Would buy again!
